long.description:
Which animal kills the most people? Not the shark. Meatball ranks the deadliest animals on Earth by how many people they actually kill: sharks (about nine a year), the kissing bug that bites your face while you sleep, the dog (rabies), the snake that warns you by sizzling, and the tiny winner that kills more than half a million people a year.

Which animal are you most scared of? Best answer gets read out next time 👇

0:00 Cold open
0:35 Sharks: the one you're scared of
1:31 The kissing bug
2:23 The dog
3:43 The snake that sizzles
4:42 Number one
5:21 How it finds you
6:02 So, what's the lesson?

Saturday: another weird true story.

shorts.title: Sharks Kill Way Fewer People Than You Think 🦈
shorts.description:
Sharks kill fewer people than you think. In 2025, the whole world had nine unprovoked fatal shark bites. Nine. Scientists log every confirmed bite worldwide; most years see somewhere between five and ten unprovoked deaths.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

shorts.title: The Bug That Bites Your Face While You Sleep 🪲
shorts.description:
This bug bites people on the face while they sleep. It's called the kissing bug. Kissing bugs live mostly in Latin America, and some kinds live in the southern United States.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

Photos (iNaturalist), cropped and color-adjusted: Kissing bug: Tyler Bishop (CC BY), Millie Basden (CC BY), Rosario Douglas (CC BY). creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0 · creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0

shorts.title: Dogs Kill More People Than Sharks. Here's How 🐕
shorts.description:
Dogs kill far more people than sharks. Tens of thousands a year. But not with their teeth. If an animal bites you, wash the wound with soap and water for about 15 minutes and get medical help fast.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

shorts.title: This Snake Warns You by Sizzling 🐍
shorts.description:
This snake warns you with a sound like sizzling. It rubs its scales together. The saw-scaled viper is one of India's 'Big Four', the snakes behind most serious bites there.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

shorts.title: The Deadliest Animal on Earth Is Tiny 🦟
shorts.description:
The deadliest animal in the world is the mosquito. In 2024, malaria alone killed about six hundred thousand people. Malaria is spread by some female Anopheles mosquitoes; about 95% of cases and deaths are in Africa.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

Photos (iNaturalist), cropped and color-adjusted: Malaria mosquito (Anopheles): Patrick Hacker (CC BY), Igor Balashov (CC BY), Randy A Nonenmacher (CC BY). creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0 · creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0
shorts.comment: How many did you swat this year? 👇 Follow Meatball for more 🍝

shorts.title: Mosquitoes Find You by Smelling Your Breath 🦟
shorts.description:
A mosquito finds you by smelling the carbon dioxide in your breath, from metres away. Then it follows your heat, and your smell. Female mosquitoes sense carbon dioxide with special organs near their mouthparts.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths
